alert_friend_week: computed on a friend's machine: {n} (7 days)
empty: No application has access to AIODOS yet. An application asks for it on its own (“Connect to AIODOS”): a card then appears here.
help: An app that leaks its key only compromises itself: revoke it here, it takes effect at once (its answers in progress stop). The log never keeps the content of requests.
edit_intro: Changes apply right away, with the same key.
edit_pin: Bind the key to its program
keep_one: Keep at least one permission and one circle.
add_text: A manual key for a tool that speaks “OpenAI” or “Ollama”: conversation on this PC and my machines, without friends. It will be shown only once.
key_text: Copy it into the tool now (as its “API key”): AIODOS won't show it again.
revoke_text: Its requests in progress stop. To come back, {name} will have to ask for access again.
